purpose: Make part of automated scientific decision preparation usable now, retain the means, and construct a different accepted decision tool with those means.
flagship_dependency: Executable scientific recommendations that carry their source evidence and can be independently accepted, with reusable construction means for a distinct successor.
programme_status: Supporting instrument delivered. This candidate does not establish the consequential newly attainable economic outcome required for Blue Sky admission.

outcomes.first: Five explicit recorded reaction-condition recipes cover all ten source substrates at 90% of each substrate's recorded maximum; five is the exact minimum.
outcomes.retained: The unchanged 8216-byte cover.py constructs a finite minimum cover and a portable optimality certificate.
outcomes.successor: Six of 33 source substrates preserve all 253 recorded ligand-pair distinctions at a 20-percentage-point gap in the ethanol reference matrix; six is the exact minimum.
outcomes.today_utility: Reproducible reference-decision preparation: explicit recipes and assignments, a reference substrate panel, source-linked witnesses, and independent finite optimality checks.
outcomes.utility_boundary: The outputs concern already published complete tables. Beneficiary adoption, prospective laboratory improvement and economic benefit have not been measured.

mechanism.reference: Vincent Boucher, OUT-EVOLVE: Building the Means of Discovery and Production, 20 October 2026
mechanism.pages: 8: freeze/retain and construct a distinct accepted function; 14: succession comparisons; 19–21: strong fresh-method ties and comparison limits.
mechanism.adoption: Freeze working generic source; construct a different adapter; independently qualify the new source-to-decision result; execute ordinary-reuse and competent fresh alternatives.
assumptions: The new incidence relation correctly represents its declared finite objective.
Original source identities and recorded numerical semantics are preserved.
The planned successor family and prior exposure are disclosed in evidence/EXPOSURE_NOTE.json.
The manuscript guides construction and comparison; it is not external validation of this experiment.
mechanism.invalidation: Changed data, thresholds, output semantics or source identities require new acceptance. Assay uncertainty, new chemistry and prospective measurements require additional domain evidence. Prior certificates and code provenance do not establish those claims.

comparisons.strong_exact_alternatives: HiGHS and independently authored exact DP/DFS match all fifteen optima.
comparisons.ordinary_reuse: A separate identical source copy matches all ten successor mathematical outputs and certificates across five repetitions per arm.
comparisons.comparison_limit: Fresh comparators measure complete source-to-accepted-decision computation, while transfer timings measure solve plus proof replay. Neither supplies matched full acquisition and complete-deliverable costs.

unknown: actual included model and host billing
resources_and_effects.financial_actions: No spending account, purchase, financing agreement or transaction was created. Included execution is not evidence of zero economic cost.
resources_and_effects.production_status: Optional research tools. Mainline integration, release qualification and autonomous engine execution are separate and not established by this experiment.

lessons.tried: Apply a newly constructed exact instrument to two distinct chemistry design objectives.
lessons.outcome: Both work; strong exact conventional routes and ordinary reuse tie.
lessons.why: The objectives reduce to established finite covering problems. The retained implementation transfers, but no residual beyond the complete incumbent route is demonstrated.
lessons.next_or_avoid: Keep the working source and evidence. Do not rebrand ordinary reuse, a greedy-only gain or smaller retrospective panels as economic invention.

lessons.tried: Check the finite mathematical certificate before full beneficiary-facing semantics.
lessons.outcome: The initial check was narrower than the complete output contract.
lessons.why: A correct mathematical answer alone does not validate displayed recipes, original yields, assignments or omitted-pair descriptions.
lessons.next_or_avoid: Independently reconstruct and verify those fields. The final source-semantic checker rejects all 36 registered proof/output mutations.

lessons.tried: Use naive subset enumeration as a successor exact baseline.
lessons.outcome: Interrupted before a complete result; failure preserved in independent/INTERRUPTED_BASELINE.json.
lessons.why: The enumeration expands combinatorially. The protocol-permitted independent exact DFS gives the strong complete comparison.
lessons.next_or_avoid: Use the competent exact method without changing data, thresholds or the declared cohort. Do not count the repaired exposed-data run as fresh confirmation.

lessons.tried: Join successor and conventional records by their separation threshold.
lessons.outcome: The first transfer-wrapper execution raised KeyError before producing a control receipt.
lessons.why: One producer encoded the threshold as an integer and the other as a decimal string.
lessons.next_or_avoid: Normalize the comparison key and check complete case identity. Mathematical outputs and frozen scientific sources were unchanged.

lessons.tried: Review the final audit and transfer wrappers before publication.
lessons.outcome: Review found an empty-cohort success path, insufficient conventional-result binding and incomplete claimed-code-provenance checks.
lessons.why: Positive summary fields and exact cardinalities alone do not validate the complete declared cohort or the provenance of an accepted result.
lessons.next_or_avoid: Reject incomplete cohorts and mismatched provenance; require source-bound acceptance and concrete CLI rejection regressions. Historical receipts remain scoped to their actual checker versions.

next_consequential_test: A prospective beneficiary decision with a declared acceptance threshold and calibrated measurement uncertainty, compared with the strongest complete incumbent workflow under matched acquisition, construction, verification and operating resources. Count new observations and complete costs; do not count existing public rows as experiments saved. This is a missing proof condition, not an executed or authorized laboratory campaign.
